name: Spanish marjoram oil
description: Spanish marjoram oil (CAS 8016-33-9 ) is a steam-distilled essential oil derived from the Spanish marjoram herb. It delivers a sharp, herbaceous, thyme-like aromatic profile that distinguishes it from sweet marjoram oil. This makes it a distinct raw material for flavor and fragrance sourcing. In food manufacturing, it functions as a flavoring agent in meat seasonings, processed foods, and savory snack formulations where a robust character is required. Fragrance compounders use it to build herbal and Mediterranean-style accords in personal care products. This includes applications in soaps, shampoos, and body washes where a natural aromatic profile is desired by the consumer. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers incorporate it into topical preparations and oral care products. Its aromatic intensity supports product differentiation in competitive markets and specialized therapeutic applications. Cosmetic formulators also apply it in aromatherapy blends and functional skincare lines targeting natural ingredient positioning. The oil is supplied as a mobile, clear to pale yellow liquid for easy integration. It is available in food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with quality benchmarks typically aligned to standard essential oil industry parameters. This includes rigorous GC/MS profile verification for every batch. Packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes.
